lines.text: Sixty thousand people out there. They have been waiting for you all day.
Your bag. I counted them twice. They're all there.
Even the one with no name on it.
Go on. You know why.
NINE YEARS EARLIER
You've been at that listening station for an hour. I close in ten minutes.
So you mix. On a laptop. With the sync button. Mm.
Sync is training wheels, kid. One day you take them off.
Here. White label. No name, no artist, nothing.
Play it when you know why.
This is it? A plastic controller with a sync button? Fine. Make them dance, superstar.
Ignore him. He's been like that since we were eight. Go on. Show him.
Two desk lamps, one bedsheet, and a red sock. Behold: the light show!
Doors are open. Well, the door. Six people. Your night. Go.
02:14. MUM BANGS ON THE WALL.
NEXT SATURDAY: SOMEBODY'S GARAGE.
END OF CHAPTER 1
You're the DJ? Good. I'm Sara. I'll be right there, in front. Don't make me stop.
That's Sara. She dances to anything. Don't test it.
